shape: 3 pairs x ab/ba x 5 rungs x {light,heavy} = 60 leaves, all 60 comparison_eligible
driver: wrk2 open-loop at a fixed offered rate (percentiles = true service time)

config.cpu_pinning: NONE (matches 60707c4): 2 resident pair-targets + wrk2 loadgen share cores 0-3,8-11; DB holds 4-7,12-15

heavy_finding: Below saturation (2-8k) all three overlap ~2.5-4.6ms within n=4 noise. At the 10k knee (~91% of the DB ceiling) tails diverge: exeris p99 degrades MOST (16.5ms), quarkus-tuned holds best (5.1ms), quarkus-hibernate mid (9.9ms). Descriptive; absolute p99 inflated for all three by the unpinned loadgen contention, but the relative ordering is a same-conditions fair comparison.
light_achieved_shortfall: quarkus-tuned achieved<<offered at 15k(13736)/20k(17024)/25k(20808); exeris + quarkus-hibernate achieved=offered through 25k.
light_finding: exeris + quarkus-hibernate scale cleanly to 25k (~2ms flat, achieved=offered). quarkus-tuned COLLAPSES above ~14k (p99 in seconds, cannot sustain the rate). CONFOUND: quarkus-tuned did ~47k light ISOLATED (2026-07-22 memory-cpu matrix). This is a CPU-SCHEDULING-CONTENTION sensitivity of quarkus-tuned's native-epoll under the unpinned shared-core triad, NOT an isolated-latency result. The light single-read is too CPU-cheap to isolate cleanly with 2 resident targets + loadgen unpinned. A clean light saturation curve needs CPU pinning (loadgen/target isolation) the 2-resident-target triad cannot provide on 16 cores with the DB on 8.
caveats: NO CPU pinning (matches 60707c4): absolute p99 inflated by loadgen + resident-target contention; relative comparisons at a given rung are same-conditions.
n=4 per point (2 pairs x ab/ba); p99 at the knee is noisy - directions are solid, magnitudes indicative.
Raw JFR (75GB, 140 files) retained on the perf-box only; excluded from the committed artifacts (public-track confidentiality default-deny + size).
Endpoint-contract-test gate skipped (BENCHMARK_SKIP_ENDPOINT_CONTRACT_GATE=1) so its maven compile+test never ran during a measure window (it was observed contaminating p99).
Descriptive_only within the comparative gate: all 60 leaves passed the stage7 gates (comparison_eligible, latency publishable / open_loop_fixed_rate).
